headline: Last session: Sensex falls 289 points on inflation concerns, though benchmark indices post third weekly gain.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on Indian equities during the last trading session.
Strong foreign institutional investor (FII) buying provided support across the trading week.
Positive Q2 corporate earnings boosted market sentiment in earlier sessions.
A global rotation trade away from AI stocks helped fuel momentum in Indian equities.
whatHappening: In the last trading session, Sensex fell 289 points while Nifty also posted losses.
Indian stock markets successfully extended gains for a third consecutive week.
GIFT Nifty had signaled a weak opening prior to Friday's decline.
Markets recorded significant wealth addition earlier in the week amid robust domestic buying.
summary: On the last trading day, Sensex slipped 289 points as inflation worries impacted investor sentiment. Despite Friday's pullback, Indian equities secured a third straight weekly gain backed by FII inflows and solid Q2 earnings. The market is closed today for the weekend and reopens on Monday.
